races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Mark Rowntree: Jamie Snowden's LORD DU GOUET is selected to go one place better than on his recent hurdles debut at Fontwell.

races.name: Dandara Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: The best form in points and bumpers belongs to NO WALKOVER , while Bob Bishop appeals most among the rest.

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Ben Hutton: Sam England has enjoyed a productive autumn and WIND YOUR NECK IN is taken to rediscover the winning thread.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: Drawn low, RAYASTAR is given the vote to show improvement from a 6f debut run in which he made late progress after a sluggish start.

races.name: Edwina Jones 80th Birthday Celebrations Novices' Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Chris Wilson: Manhattan Valley is interesting but preference is for WANNABE , who was probably unlucky not to finish second over C&D last month.

races.name: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: With a low draw and a 10lb claimer in the saddle, THE BEAR TRAP may cope with the 4lb extra imposed for last Wednesday's win.

races.name: Support Your Oncourse Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

verdicts.rp: by Chris Wilson: It's hard to get away from hurdling debutant MERRY AWAY , who was fourth in a big-field Grade 2 bumper at Aintree in the spring.

races.name: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: Plenty with chances but JAZZIT retains plenty of appeal in this grade.

races.name: QuinnBet Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Ben Hutton: There can be optimism that the 6yo SCAIRP DUBH (nap) still has more to offer and he can add to his chase debut win over C&D in May.

races.name: 3A's Leisure Novices' Handicap Hurdle

verdicts.rp: by Jonathan Doidge: Moderate fayre and it could be a good opportunity for NO BOUNDARIES (nap) to deliver on the promise of his Worcester reappearance effort.

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap (0-60)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: A ready winner on AW debut here last week over a mile, ROCK ON JOHNNY should have the speed for this shorter trip.

races.name: Welsh Cottage Christmas Cakes Handicap Chase

verdicts.rp: by Richard Austen: Cath Williams runs four, with EVERYONESACRITIC and Leech making most appeal. Unleash The Beast may yet come good.

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Maiden

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: Otsana looks a strong player, but STOOKED gets marginal preference on AW debut.

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)

verdicts.rp: by David Moon: This looks tricky, but course winner TREDEGER SQUARE shaped as though this drop in trip could suit last time and he gets the vote.

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Alan Sweetman: Back to 1m after finishing third over 7f here last week, GO OUT can enhance his evolving record at this venue with Colin Keane's help.

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)

verdicts.rp: by David Moon: This can go to ANGEL FOOTSTEPS , who sets a clear standard on her second at Redcar in April and is open to progress on her return.

races.name: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Fillies Maiden

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: Looking to be crying out for this longer trip on debut, RHAPSODIC (nap) can improve to score, at the expense of Serendipia.

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60)

verdicts.rp: by Alan Hewison: Robot Rock is entitled to be popular on his recent C&D 2nd, but PRADA'S WORLD may be open to greater improvement now upped in trip.

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Nursery

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: You're Sensational (second choice) is open to progress now tackling nurseries but DIAMONDISE can build on his Southwell effort.

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Cooper: Andrew Balding's STERLING COOPER took a big step forward from first run to second and can improve again for moving up to 1m.

races.name: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Cooper: Godolphin colt PALLADAS (nap) is taken to get back to winning ways and extend his unbeaten record on AW to three.

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Andrew Cooper: This is a drop in class for COMIC HERO and his second in a hot race at Newmarket two runs ago reads particularly well.

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap

verdicts.rp: by Harry March: The well bred CROWN OF CROWNS looks capable of further progress, with Maestro Del Mar next on the list in added cheekpieces.
